title: Patient referral
goal: Show referral exchange between two healthcare organisations.

rubric.must: Clinic and Specialist are separate pools.
Referral and Appointment are dashed message flows crossing pools.
Each pool has internal solid sequence flows only.
An event-based gateway is visible after Triage referral.
Referral needed and Booked are start and end events.

ideal.notes: Drafted by Codex from the source and the rubric, without seeing the engine's own output. It preferred the svg: The SVG satisfies all five rules, while the picture depicts a different workflow and lacks the required Appointment message flow, event-based gateway, and Booked end event.
